# Synthetic media fixtures

`memory.png` and `memory.webm` are original test assets generated locally with a Canvas
and Chrome MediaRecorder (VP8 WebM, 640 × 360, approximately one second).
They contain only colored backgrounds and the text “Synthetic memory media test”.
There are no personal photos, memories, or third-party assets.

The checked-in video was decoded and played in Chrome before saving. A fixed fixture
keeps upload/playback tests independent of headless Canvas capture scheduling.
